paite: Migilou kuamah delh louh in atai; himahleh midiktat humpinelkai bang in ahangsan hi.
Gam tatlekna ziak in thuneimi tampi a-om a; himahleh theisiam leh theihna nei mite ziak in huai gam bel suk vaiveng theih ahi.
Taksap hau migenthei nuaisiahte zaw lou susia vuahpi zu bang ahi.
Amau dan mangngilhte'n migilou aphat ua; himahleh huchibang dan zuite amau tung ah athangpai uhi.
Mihoih lou in vaihawmna atheisiam kei; himahleh amau TOUPA zongte'n thil tengteng atheisiam uh.
Alampite a hoih lou mihau sang in athutakna a om migenthei ahoihzaw hi.
Kuapeuh dan zui tapa pil ahi; himahleh kuapeuh anhai mite toh kithuah in apa azumsak hi.
Kuapeuh aneih, anou leh apung tamsak in, migenthei hehpihmi amah a ding in alakhawm hi.
Kuapeuh dan za lou ding a abil kaihei, athumna nangawn kihhuai ahi.
Kuapeuh lampi gilou a midik lamhaihsak, ama kokhuk mahmah ah akelut ding hi; himahleh mihoihkim in gou hoih aluah ding hi.
Mihausa ama ngaih in apil a; himahleh migenthei theihsiamna nei in amah azongkhia hi.
Midiktat avualzoh chiang in, thupina lian a-om; himahleh migilou athoh chiang in, mite abu uhi.
Kuapeuh atatlekna khuh alohching kei ding; himahleh kuapeuh huaite thupha tawi a, mangngilh in zahngaihna amu ding uh.
Lau thei gige mi ahampha hi; himahleh alungtang saksak gige siatna ah ake ding hi.
Humpinelkai humham leh vompi hawk bang in; huai mah bang in migentheite tung a vaihawmmi gilou ahi.
Vaihawmmi theihsiamna tasam nuaisiah hat mithupi ahi; himahleh kuapeuh huaihamna hua in anite asausak ding hi.
Mi kuapeuh sisan a dimmi himhim, kokhuk sung ah atailut ding; kuamah in panpih kei hen.
Kuapeuh tangtak a om suahtaksak in a-om ding; himahleh kuapeuh alampite a hoih lou apuk zaw ding hi.
Kuapeuh agam lei let in tanghou tampi anei ding; himahleh kuapeuh mi bangmah lou nungzui in gentheihna kiching anei ding hi.
Miginom in vualzawlna ahau ding; himahleh kuapeuh hau ding a kintat gawt louh in a-om kei ding hi.
Mite deihsak tuam neih ahoih kei; tanghou them ziak in mi atalek ding leng ahi sam kei hi.
Kuapeuh deihgawl sumchit hauhsakna delh in akinoh a, huan atung ah taksapna ahong tung sin chih athei kei hi.
Kuapeuh mi deihsakna a sal in alei a maitangphat hatmi sang in deihsakna tamsem anung in amu ding hi.
Kuapeuh anu hiam apa hiam lok a, "Tatlekna ahi kei," chimi zaw; amah mah hihsemi kithuahpih ahi hi.
Kuapeuh lungsim duhgawl in kinakna atokthou hi; himahleh kuapeuh TOUPA a muanna koih thausak in a-om ding hi.
Kuapeuh ama lungtang muang mihai ahi; himahleh kuapeuh piltak a om, suahtaksak in a-om ding hi.
Kuapeuh genthei kiang a pia atasam kei ding a; himahleh kuapeuh amit sel in hamsia tampi anei ding hi.
Migiloute alal chiang un, mite akibu ua; himahleh amanthat chiang un, midiktat apung hi.
